description.value: Freshii is a Canadian quick-service restaurant chain founded in Toronto in 2005, now with over 300 locations worldwide. The Wesbrook Mall location offers a health-focused menu of salads, energy bowls, burritos, wraps, poke bowls, and smoothies, all fully customizable. Touring cyclists will find it a convenient stop for a nutritious, build-your-own meal in the UBC/Wesbrook Village area.
